evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Scope is broad (search + discovery) and the capability could range from simple lookup to full fingerprinting pipeline and recommendation UX, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified what “profile” contains and what “discover” entails (ranking, recommendations, filters), leading to wide implementation variance.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Requires defining similarity model, data sources, and discovery UX; too many open choices for reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Cross-media similarity and output types (music vs ringback tones) are broad and technically variable; insufficiently bounded for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Does not specify which metadata/tags, how they are obtained, or what discovery paths are required; scope can expand significantly.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Clear functional behavior (upload + persist tags for downstream processing); while integration details exist, the scope is bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Concrete UI capability with limited scope (generate/display thumbnails per segment), enabling reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: “Similar” and “info” are undefined (similarity method, returned fields, UI/API), making effort highly variable.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity can imply complex CV/AV models and unclear outputs; insufficiently specified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation logic, similarity definition, and delivery mechanism are unspecified, yielding a coarse-grained requirement.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Requires defining “relevant news events,” sourcing news, geolocation, and recommendation approach; too open-ended to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification in video plus “related information” spans complex recognition, data linkage, and UX; not bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product recognition in video and unspecified “related information” is broad and technically variable, hindering estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection might be estimatable alone, but adding “related information” without defining content/source broadens scope too much.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification and unspecified follow-up information is a coarse-grained, open-ended capability.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is underspecified (matching method, relevance, UX), leading to large estimation variance.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Combines mapping, geofencing, POI detection, and notification; “any other relevant point of interest” is unbounded, making it hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search could mean integrating an ASR service, building indexing, handling languages, etc.; too underspecified for consistent estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Clear admin workflow (view/validate/edit segmentation); while UI details vary, the functional scope is bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Defined task (annotation + topic per segment) with a reasonably bounded outcome, enabling estimation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: “A/V quality aspects” and ranking criteria are unspecified; could range from simple metadata filters to complex signal analysis.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: “Edited” detection is ambiguous (what edits, what confidence, what method), making implementation scope hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering could mean manual rules, ML classification, thresholds, and moderation workflow; insufficiently specified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset information and search capabilities are undefined; scope could vary widely (indexes, query language, UI).

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement detection is a large, complex domain with many possible approaches and requirements; too coarse-grained to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Search/prefilter behavior, supported fields, and ranking are not specified; could range from simple filtering to advanced search system.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Multiple subjective constructs (interesting/appealing/complex) and multiple data sources without defined outputs/metrics make it hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Trigger conditions, prompt mechanism, and decision logic are unspecified; could require complex modeling and workflow integration.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: “Volunteer types” is undefined (taxonomy, features, method), making the requirement too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Bounded by “simple low-level image features” and a clear task (preclassification), making estimation feasible.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection goal (empty/no classifiable animals) with clear scope, enabling estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: “Image series detection” and handling of timestamp malfunction are not defined (criteria, outputs, correction actions), making scope unclear.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species set, performance expectations, and integration point are unspecified; could range from baseline classifier to production-grade ML pipeline.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: “Attributes” are undefined and could be numerous/complex; insufficiently bounded for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals can vary greatly by definition (per frame vs per image, occlusion handling, species), not specified enough to estimate well.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: “Segmentation or localization” leaves scope open (bounding boxes vs masks, accuracy), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection objective (no classifiable plankton) is bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: “Size” and “orientation” definitions, measurement units, and required precision are unspecified; scope can vary widely.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species set and expected performance/integration are not specified; could be small prototype or full production classifier.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis approach and what “reduce video duration” means (summarization rules, thresholds) are unspecified, making estimation hard.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Detection requirements (precision, confidence, multiple events) and method are unspecified; could be very complex depending on constraints.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Multiple feature types with open-ended “etc” makes scope unbounded and difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting model, inputs defining “experience,” and how weights are used are unspecified; estimation varies widely.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact types and removal approach are not bounded (detection vs correction, list of artifacts), making scope hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: “Moving and transient objects” is broad and depends on data characteristics and definitions; insufficiently specified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise types, acceptable artifacts, and processing constraints are unspecified; could range from simple filtering to advanced source separation.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Similarity definition, grouping method (clustering vs classification), and outputs are unspecified, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales from audio depends on definitions (simultaneous callers, call types) and required accuracy; not specified enough to estimate well.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption triggers, channels, and decision logic are undefined; could entail complex behavioral modeling and experimentation.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Requires defining decision criteria and content generation/selection; too underspecified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education triggers and measurement of need are unspecified; broad behavioral requirement hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Decision logic and content selection/creation are not defined, making scope highly variable.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires defining education catalog, matching logic, and delivery; too open-ended to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: “Interesting comment” is subjective and undefined; detection could range from simple heuristics to NLP models, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Triggering rules and bot behavior are unspecified; could involve complex policy and NLP, making estimation hard.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation triggers and what constitutes an explanation are undefined; scope is broad and variable.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Open-ended natural language generation/content policy requirement without constraints; not estimatable as a single story.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Similarity basis, grouping method, and intended use/output are unspecified; could be trivial or complex, hindering estimation.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation logic and definition of “previous experiences” are unspecified; could require significant data modeling and experimentation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: “Summary” is underspecified (length, format, source, automatic vs manual), making implementation scope unclear and hard to estimate.
